subject: z-tests to compare population abundances that have been obtained

messages.author: 46779c401485f9d4
messages.subject: z-tests to compare population abundances that have been obtained
parts:
Dear Distance Users,

I want to compare 3 abundance estimates of the same group/population of
inshore bottlenose dolphins that live in Moreton Bay, Southern Queensland,
Australia. Two of these estimates have been obtained using photo-id
mark-recapture methods and have been analysed using a program called
CAPTURE while the third estimate was obtained using line-transects and
analysed using DISTANCE. Is this possible using Z-tests and the variances
calculated for each in their respective programs?

Thanks

Vimoksalehi
